summary:
Comprehensive pytest test suite for PakkaSolar backend. Tests are organized in three groups:
1. Pure logic tests (no AWS): calc_subsidy, check_price, build_verdict — no mocking needed
2. AWS tool tests (moto mocked): check_almm, check_vendor, calc_generation (including ANN key bug regression), parse_quote (MOCK_MODE + Pydantic validators)
3. Lambda handler tests (moto mocked): webhook_handler upload flow, status_handler polling, audit_worker full pipeline in MOCK_MODE

Also includes an import smoke test that catches missing deps or wrong paths before deployment.
